page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfg6.20xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal instance running on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 80 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 3.1 GHz. The platform is paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, delivering approximately 4.8 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This bare metal deployment provides direct hardware access managed through a KVM hypervisor architecture without virtualization overhead on dedicated compute.

The instance includes no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for operating system images and persistent data persistence. Network connectivity is delivered via a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput node communications. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default, requiring allocation via elastic IPs for external network ingress and egress. It does not incorporate hardware GPU accelerators.

With an allocation of 4.8 GB of memory per core alongside high base clock speeds of 3.1 GHz, the server maintains balance between compute throughput and memory capacity. The absence of local disk implies dependency on remote block storage latency, which must be factored into storage-intensive deployments. The ecs.ebmhfg6.20xlarge is suited for enterprise application hosting, batch compute pipelines, large-scale continuous integration workers, in-memory data processing, and distributed database cluster nodes.
